turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner and I want to read the same book together.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a fun idea. Would you both read separately and compare notes, or read it aloud to each other?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need to talk to my roommate for a second. Stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, turn around. Is that a tick on the back of your leg?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Stay still. It's tiny, just behind your knee.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Don't squeeze it, I read you're not supposed to squeeze them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I know. Have you got those tweezers in the first aid bag?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Front pocket. Oh, I hate this.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it, all of it. Head and everything.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Thank you. I'm wearing long trousers next time, no matter how hot it is.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. The book with your partner. Reading aloud or comparing notes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Separately, he reads way faster than me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then agree on a stopping point each week so he can't spoil anything.
